payload.reason: The evidence indicates that both single-language and multilingual BERT models perform well in capturing syntax-sensitive agreement patterns, but does not definitively state that one outperforms the other across all contexts.

claims.text: Single-language BERT and multilingual BERT both capture syntax-sensitive agreement patterns well.
The performance of BERT models varies by linguistic context, but no clear superiority of single-language over multilingual BERT is established.
BERT's performance is influenced by the difficulty of the datasets for different languages, complicating direct comparisons.
